html.content:
Recommended

Heatmapscore: 1.0

Color-coded matrix — rows × columns with optional clustering and dendrograms.

Clinical use: AE incidence by SOC × arm, gene expression heatmap

  • many numeric vars → matrix view
  • enough rows for matrix

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='heatmap of <numeric> with <factor1> rows and <factor2> columns'

Alternatives

ParallelCoordinatesscore: 0.95

Parallel axes — each line is an observation, axes are variables.

Clinical use: Multi-endpoint profile per subject, multivariate QC

  • 3+ numeric → parallel axes
  • colour lines by category
  • 4+ axes — parallel coordinates clearer than heatmap

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='parallel coordinates of <numeric variables> colored by <factor>'

Scatter2Dscore: 0.9

Points on x/y axes revealing correlation between two numeric variables.

Clinical use: Biomarker vs response, PK/PD, PCA plot by treatment

  • 2+ numeric → x/y scatter
  • colour by category
  • sufficient points

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='scatter plot of <num1> vs <num2> colored by <factor>'

Dotplotscore: 0.85

Individual data points per group — best when n < ~50 per group.

Clinical use: Individual lab values, small Phase I cohorts

  • cat + numeric
  • small n — show every point

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='dot plot of <numeric> by <factor>'

Scatter3Dscore: 0.85

3D scatter for three continuous dimensions.

Clinical use: Multivariate exploratory analysis

  • 3 numeric → x/y/z scatter
  • colour by category

generate_canvasxpress_config with description='3D scatter of <num1> vs <num2> vs <num3>'
